PAYMENTS FOR YOUR PURCHASE

Snap Finance

An installment option for the service you need.

The shop’s Snap application offers a Snap Loan branded retail installment contract, letting you make payments over time.

  • Apply online in minutes.
  • Snap advertises a decision in seconds.
  • A payment arrangement for your purchase, rather than a reusable credit card.

Review the payment schedule and total cost in your offer before accepting. Approval and terms are determined by the provider.

Apply with SnapHow Snap works

A CARD FOR ONGOING CAR CARE

Synchrony
Car Care

One card for eligible automotive purchases.

Synchrony Car Care is a credit card accepted at participating automotive merchants, with no annual fee.

  • Use it again for eligible purchases within your available credit.
  • Six-month promotional financing on eligible purchases of $199 or more.
  • Manage your account and payments online.

No interest if paid in full within six months. Otherwise, interest is charged from the purchase date. Minimum monthly payments are required. Subject to credit approval. Ask the shop about its current Synchrony program.

Call about SynchronyCard benefits & terms

Compare the total.
Not just the payment.

Before choosing, compare the total repayment cost, payment dates, fees and any promotional deadline. The providers set their own terms; the shop can help you find the right application.
